Subject: Re: Debrief + quick scorecard for Avery Evans (SWE III)

Marissa / Laura — added my scorecard in GH but want to call out a substantive concern that I think pulls my overall to a "no" unless we do one focused loop: complexity assumptions in the caching design.

On the system design question, Avery suggested a KV cache strategy that assumes strong locality over 99% of traffic; in our environment those assumptions don't hold (multi-tenant inference) and the recovery story was fuzzy. If the hiring bar includes ownership of large-scale cache correctness, I think we need a short follow-up on consistency/eviction correctness.

Proposed options:
- Brief follow-up with candidate (30 min) focused on cache correctness & multi-tenant failure modes
- Or, if we want to avoid another interview, move to "defer" and let SE owners validate during onboarding (less ideal)

I'm available Tue 10/27 10:00–11:30 or Wed 10/28 14:00–16:00 for a synchronous tiebreak call if useful.

—Jonas
